scope: Read-only review of local trainer, data encoder, collator and installed Transformers 4.56.2 source; no GPU quality claim.

resolved_findings.issue: Exception after completed=True could leave a failed adapter eligible for runtime admission.
resolved_findings.resolution: Trainer exception handler now sets completed=False and failed=True; runtime also rejects failed=True.

resolved_findings.issue: Generic training file admission did not require the approved release SHA.
resolved_findings.resolution: Formal runs require --data-sha256, checked against bytes before row admission and checked again afterward.

verified_design.completion_encoding: Complete literal text encoded once plus one EOS, with no truncation
verified_design.actual_exposure: Counts only successful training_step calls, including each accumulated microbatch; records row and source-group coverage
verified_design.formal_coverage_gate: Every row must have at least the configured integer number of epoch visits
verified_design.adapter_change_gate: Initial and final LoRA fingerprints must differ
verified_design.saved_weight_gate: Safetensors keys and all live tensors compared bitwise
verified_design.base_hash_scope: Configuration and tokenizer only; receipt does not claim base-weight hashing
verified_design.optimizer_resume: save_only_model=True does not preserve optimizer state for exact continuation

loss_normalization_review.denominator: Non-masked completion tokens summed over the accumulation group
loss_normalization_review.qwen3_loss: Cross entropy sum divided by num_items_in_batch
loss_normalization_review.Accelerator_creation: Trainer handles accumulation; no gradient_accumulation_steps argument passed to Accelerator

formal_baseline_plan.stage_training: Separate entity and relation causal LoRA adapters from the same base
formal_baseline_plan.checkpoint_selection: Fixed final checkpoint, not best epoch selection
formal_baseline_plan.final_acceptance: Actual observed exposure, finite statistics, changed adapter weights, exact saved tensors, then complete frozen evaluation

comparison_caveats: Equal epochs match annotation-atom visits but do not equalize optimizer updates, prompt tokens or compute.
Short-source extra target tokens are exactly its extra EOS boundaries; the other added tokens are prompts and repeated input entity tables.
At batch size 1 and accumulation 8, per-epoch updates are 84/68 for full entity/relation and 137/119 for short views.
Short-source versus short-canonical holds row count, atom count, EOS count and update count fixed, while changing ordering and its prompt wording.
Runtime currently uses full-source entity extraction; a future short-trained entity arm must disclose or resolve that training/inference context difference.
The current plan fixes the final two-epoch checkpoint; save_total_limit=2 is sufficient for that plan but not for retaining every checkpoint of a future longer run.

review_scope_by_file.agent/semantic/train.py: Trainer setup, loss forwarding, observed exposure, data admission and save/exception gates
review_scope_by_file.agent/semantic/runtime.py: check_adapter_contract receipt admission only; not an independent full-runtime review
review_scope_by_file.agent/semantic/data.py: Prompt/completion encoding, EOS, split admission and no-truncation

cpu_test_command: PYTHONPATH=agent python -m pytest -q agent/tests/test_semantic_train.py agent/tests/test_semantic_data.py agent/tests/test_semantic_runtime.py
